items.text:
This is a very alpha product, so don't buy this with the assumption it's a fully playable game.  There are missing features and frequent game breaking bugs.  At the moment, there is no save feature either.

That said, I've been wanting to play around with this thing ever since I first got wind of it, and this alpha build lets me do that.  I don't mind paying for the opportunity because the developers have a good track record with NEO Scavenger and I'm confident this game will get the development and polish needed.  

Just be aware that this is an alpha build and not a finished product.
items.text_zh:
这是一个非常早期的alpha产品，所以不要以为它是一款完全可玩的游戏而购买。有缺失的功能和频繁的破坏游戏进程的bug。目前也没有存档功能。

话虽如此，自从我第一次听说这个东西以来，我就一直想玩玩看，而这个alpha版本让我能够做到这一点。我不介意为此付费，因为开发者在NEO Scavenger上有良好的记录，我相信这款游戏会得到所需的开发和打磨。

只是要知道这是一个alpha版本，而不是成品。
